result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.count_edges()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Count the total number of edges in the graph. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L3702-L3771){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.count_edges() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Returns the current number of edges (links/connections) in the graph. For undirected graphs, each edge is counted once. For directed graphs, each directed edge is counted separately (`A->B` is different from `B->A`). ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The total number of edges in the graph. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#463dc2fb .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_edge(source="A", target="B") .add_edge(source="B", target="C") ) graph.count_edges() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 2 ``` ::: ::: Directedness changes what counts as a distinct edge: a directed graph counts `A->B` and `B->A` separately, while an undirected graph treats them as the same connection: ::: {#05f96bfc .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} directed = ( ec.Graph(directed=True) .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_edge(source="A", target="B") .add_edge(source="B", target="A") ) undirected = ( ec.Graph(directed=False) .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_edge(source="A", target="B") ) directed.count_edges(), undirected.count_edges() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` (2, 1) ``` ::: ::: As with nodes, deleting an edge immediately lowers the count: ::: {#c6b35116 .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_edge(source="A", target="B") .add_edge(source="B", target="C") .delete_edge(source="A", target="B") ) graph.count_edges() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` 1 ``` ::: :::
